t1.titulo: The language of science and technology
t1.descripcion:
In the scientific and technological field, specific terms and expressions are used. Below, we present the key concepts:
• investigación científica = scientific research
• desarrollo tecnológico = technological development
• innovación = innovation
• descubrimiento = discovery
• avance = breakthrough/advance
• experimento = experiment
• hipótesis = hypothesis
• teoría = theory
• ley científica = scientific law
• dato = data (plural: datos)
• muestra = sample
• resultado = result
• patente = patent
• prototipo = prototype
• inteligencia artificial = artificial intelligence
• algoritmo = algorithm
• big data = big data
• ciberseguridad = cybersecurity
• biotecnología = biotechnology
• nanotecnología = nanotechnology

📌 IMPORTANT NOTE: Many of these terms are learned words that come from Latin or Greek, so they often have cognates in Chinese. Pay attention to the difference between 'descubrimiento' (finding something that already exists) and 'invención' (creation of something new).

❌ COMMON ERROR: Chinese speakers often confuse 'tecnología' with 'técnica'. 'Tecnología' refers to the set of knowledge and processes, while 'técnica' is a specific method or skill.
ejemplos: La investigación científica es fundamental para el progreso.
El desarrollo tecnológico ha cambiado nuestras vidas.
La innovación es clave para la competitividad.
El descubrimiento de la penicilina salvó muchas vidas.
Los avances en inteligencia artificial son sorprendentes.

t4.descripcion:
To talk about innovation and technological trends, you need more specialized vocabulary. Here you have advanced terms and expressions:
• disrupción = disruption
• transformación digital = digital transformation
• sostenibilidad = sustainability
• huella de carbono = carbon footprint
• energías renovables = renewable energies
• eficiencia energética = energy efficiency
• movilidad eléctrica = electric mobility
• vehículo autónomo = autonomous vehicle
• realidad virtual = virtual reality
• realidad aumentada = augmented reality
• internet de las cosas = Internet of Things
• impresión 3D = 3D printing
• cadena de bloques = blockchain
• computación en la nube = cloud computing
• macrodatos = big data
• aprendizaje automático = machine learning
• redes sociales = social networks
• brecha digital = digital divide
• propiedad intelectual = intellectual property
• startup = startup (empresa emergente)

📌 IMPORTANT NOTE: Many of these terms have equivalents in Spanish, but English loanwords are also used. In formal contexts, Spanish terms are preferred, such as 'macrodatos' instead of 'big data', or 'aprendizaje automático' instead of 'machine learning'.

❌ COMMON MISTAKE: Chinese speakers often use the anglicism 'big data' directly, but in academic Spanish 'macrodatos' is recommended. It is also common to confuse 'sostenibilidad' with 'sustentabilidad'; in Spanish, 'sostenibilidad' is the preferred term.
ejemplos: La transformación digital es esencial para las empresas modernas.
La sostenibilidad es un objetivo clave en la innovación.
Las energías renovables reducen la huella de carbono.
El vehículo autónomo podría cambiar la movilidad urbana.
La brecha digital afecta a las zonas rurales.

t3.titulo: Describing processes and explaining how something works
t3.descripcion:
In scientific and technological contexts, it is common to describe processes, explain how devices work, or detail experiments. For this, connectors and sequence expressions are used:
• En primer lugar... = First of all...
• A continuación... = Next...
• Luego... = Then...
• Después... = Afterwards...
• Más tarde... = Later...
• Finalmente... = Finally...
• Para empezar... = To begin with...
• Al mismo tiempo... = At the same time...
• Mientras tanto... = Meanwhile...
• Una vez que... = Once...
• Antes de... = Before...
• Después de... = After...
• Al final... = At the end...
• El proceso consiste en... = The process consists of...
• Se lleva a cabo... = It is carried out...
• Se realiza... = It is done...

In addition, the passive voice is used to describe processes objectively: 'Los datos son analizados por el equipo'.

📌 IMPORTANT NOTE: In Spanish, to describe processes, the passive reflexive with 'se' is usually used: 'Se recogen las muestras', 'Se analizan los datos'. This structure is very common in scientific texts.

❌ COMMON ERROR: Chinese speakers often omit the definite article in expressions such as 'en primer lugar' (not 'en primero lugar') or 'por último' (not 'por último'). Furthermore, they avoid using the passive voice, but it is essential in formal contexts.
ejemplos: En primer lugar, se plantea la hipótesis.
A continuación, se realiza el experimento.
Luego, se recogen los datos.
Después, se analizan los resultados.
Finalmente, se extraen las conclusiones.

t2.titulo: Expressing opinion and debating about science and technology
t2.descripcion:
To participate in debates about science and technology, you need to express opinions, show agreement or disagreement, and argue. Here you have useful resources:
• En mi opinión... = In my opinion...
• Desde mi punto de vista... = From my point of view...
• Estoy de acuerdo con... = I agree with...
• No estoy de acuerdo con... = I disagree with...
• Es cierto que... pero... = It's true that... but...
• Por un lado... por otro lado... = On the one hand... on the other hand...
• Sin embargo... = However...
• No cabe duda de que... = There is no doubt that...
• Es evidente que... = It is evident that...
• Hay que tener en cuenta que... = One must take into account that...
• En cuanto a... = Regarding...
• Respecto a... = Regarding...
• Por lo que respecta a... = As far as... is concerned...
• Cabe destacar que... = It is worth noting that...
• En resumen... = In summary...

📌 IMPORTANT NOTE: In Spanish, when expressing opinions in a formal debate, the subjunctive is usually used after expressions like 'no creo que', 'es posible que', 'no es cierto que'. For example: 'No creo que la inteligencia artificial sea peligrosa'.

❌ COMMON MISTAKE: Chinese speakers tend to use 'según mí' instead of 'según yo' or 'en mi opinión'. The correct form is 'según yo' or 'en mi opinión'. 'Según mí' is incorrect.
ejemplos: En mi opinión, la tecnología facilita la vida diaria.
Desde mi punto de vista, la investigación científica debe recibir más fondos.
Estoy de acuerdo con el uso de energías renovables.
No estoy de acuerdo con esa política de innovación.
Es cierto que hay riesgos, pero los beneficios son mayores.

dict.在西班牙，最大的科学传播中心之一是格拉纳达科学公园。这座互动式博物馆于1995年: In Spain, one of the largest science communication centers is the Granada Science Park. This interactive museum opened in 1995 and receives more than half a million visitors each year. Its goal is to bring science closer to the public of all ages through exhibitions on the human body, astronomy, robotics, and sustainability. In addition, it organizes workshops and lectures where visitors can experience and discuss the latest advances. The park also collaborates with universities and companies to promote innovation and scientific vocations among young people.
dict.在中国，中国科技馆等大型科普场馆同样注重互动体验，但格拉纳达科学公园更强调公民参: In China, large science museums such as the China Science and Technology Museum also focus on interactive experiences, but the Granada Science Park places more emphasis on citizen participation in scientific debate, which differs from China's science education model.

dict.汉语母语者常把西班牙语的单颤音 r 发成汉语的 r 或 l。练习时，舌尖轻轻弹一: Native Chinese speakers often pronounce the Spanish single trill r as Chinese r or l. When practicing, tap the tip of the tongue lightly against the upper alveolar ridge for single r (as in pero), while rr requires multiple vibrations of the tongue tip (as in perro).
